fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309501/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-15 to 2026-12-31 and 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31: PeakSingleCampsite $15) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/sandy-bottoms-campground ('Camping $15/site/night'), read 2026-10-30

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/sandy-bottoms-campground ('The America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes ... entitle the pass holder to a 50% discount on camping fees'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservation only since May 1, 2025 ('There will no longer be any First Come/First Service'). 14 nights in any 30 days on Chattahoochee-Oconee NF land, then leave the forest for 30 days. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 12:01 pm.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/sandy-bottoms-campground ('All Camping is by Reservation Only. There will no longer be any First Come/First Service.'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309501 (notice 'Beginning May 1st, 2025 Sandy Bottoms campground will require reservations be made via recreation.gov for all campsites'; maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days'; minConsecutiveStay 1 soft = no rule; 'Check out time is 12:01 pm and check in time starts at 2:00 pm'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309501/campsites + RIDB catalog (all 12 public sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No, Sewer Hookup No), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 12 bookable sites (1-11 and 13) plus a management site (12); rec.gov's description says 13. Every site is a back-in. Permitted equipment on every site: tent, car/vehicle, pickup camper, pop-up (to 16 ft), trailer (sites 1-2 to 25 ft, the rest to 28 ft), and on 9 sites caravan/camper van - no RV/motorhome type is listed on any site. RIDB's Max Vehicle Length is 35 ft (site 2: 45, site 1: 50).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309501/campsites (permitted_equipment per site) + RIDB catalog for facility 10309501 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-30

values.note: rec.gov: 'Drinking water is available by hand pump during the entire season the campground is open'; the Forest Service page says 'Potable water is not available at this site'. Trash bins at the centre of the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10309501 ('There is a new vault toilet and trash bins located at the center of the campground. Drinking water is available by hand pump during the entire season the campground is open.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/sandy-bottoms-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-30

note: USFS Chattahoochee NF, Chattooga River RD, on the shore of the Tallulah River via Tallulah River Road (FS-70, gravel). No ATVs, UTVs or golf carts on the campground or the river road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 (2026 and 2027), reservation-only on rec.gov (fcfs never), no hookups, vault toilet, hand-pump water (rec.gov; FS page disagrees), Senior/Access 50%. Added 14-night max, 12 bookable back-in sites. max_rig_ft 35 -> 28 (longest trailer the catalog permits; no motorhome type listed). Season not set: FS page 03/15-10/31 vs rec.gov selling nights in November 2026 and March 2027. Note trimmed of field facts and the RV Life line.
flags: FIT QUESTION: recreation.gov lists no RV/motorhome equipment type on any of the 12 bookable sites - permitted types are tent, car/vehicle, pickup camper, pop-up (16 ft), trailer (sites 1-2 25 ft, others 28 ft) and caravan/camper van (9 sites). RIDB Max Vehicle Length 35 ft on 10 sites, 45 (site 2), 50 (site 1). The FS page gives no length. EKKO (23-ft Class C) would have to book as a trailer or camper van.
Missing phone: Chattooga River Ranger District 706-754-6221 (FS page 'Phone: 706-754-6221'; rec.gov 'For facility specific information, please call (706) 754-6221').

Season disagreement: the Forest Service page gives 'Seasons of Use 03/15 - 10/31' and 'closed for the winter season will reopen March 15, 2026' (page last updated March 16, 2026), but recreation.gov's 2026 rate season runs Mar 15 - Dec 31, 2027's Jan 1 - Dec 31, and its calendar shows November 2026 nights available/reserved (8 of 12 reserved Nov 6) and every site available March 1-14, 2027. Season left unset.

Pin 34.96322,-83.55900 is 254 m NNW of the centroid of rec.gov's per-site coordinates (34.96112,-83.55791; sites 1-13 span 34.9604-34.9620) - ~135 m past the northernmost site. Suggest moving it. (rec.gov's own facility point, 34.78675,-84.23888, is ~70 km away and wrong.)

Water conflict between official pages: rec.gov says hand-pump drinking water all season; the FS page says potable water is not available. Kept potable_water true from rec.gov with both quoted in facilities.note.
No current FS closure order or road alert covers FS-70/Tallulah River Road (Chattahoochee-Oconee alerts list read 2026-10-30; the only Chattooga River RD road closure is FSR 153A).
